about: Every state and province is its own shetach unless an entry below claims it. An entry merges areas into one shetach (territory = ISO codes: US-CA, CA-ON, ...); splits by county come later (see docs/PLAN.md). Leave headShliach empty if unknown. lastName is optional: it defaults to the last word of headShliach. capital is the shetach's headquarters: a name plus the chabad.org center id (the number in its chabad.org link), or lat and lon for a place that isn't listed. notShown = areas left off the map entirely.
